snippet_primary: "The best way to keep the highest percentage of your memberships is usually a platform that charges a flat fee (instead of a percentage). While starting on Patreon at 10% of your revenue doesn't feel like much at first, it adds up fast! Imagine that when you make $100, you'll pay Patreon $10. If you make $10,000, you'll pay Patreon $1,000. A flat fee platform like Mighty Networks, Kajabi, or ConvertKit means that you don't get penalized as you grow–you just pay the platform fee."
subject_exact: third-party article contrasting Patreon's percentage-based fee against flat-fee competitor platforms with a worked example
metric_value_raw: 10% of revenue at Patreon: $10 fee on $100 revenue; $1,000 fee on $10,000 revenue
